//: Typechecks the test tree, which `tsconfig.json` deliberately excludes.
WHY THIS EXISTS. The base config excludes __tests__ and **/*.test.ts, so 916 test files are
never typechecked. A mock is therefore free to disagree with the contract it stands for and the
suite stays green, because the test and the mock are the same author's invention checked against
each other. That bit on 2026-09-03: six passing tests mocked `recommended_actions` as
{ key, label, href, tone }, a shape the engine never produces, and the describer read `label` off
an object that has none. Only a same-artifact typecheck pair saw it, and only because it happened
to compile the SOURCE file. Nothing checks the mock itself.
🛑 `exclude` IS OVERRIDDEN, NOT INHERITED, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT. `extends` inherits
`exclude`, and an inherited `exclude` silently drops matching entries from `include` — so a config
that extended the base without this override would compile ZERO test files and report clean.
CLAUDE.md records that exact failure. Verify with `--listFiles`, never by reading the error count.
